- sex column was clean (no missing, no variants).
- No duplicate rows.

Fixes applied:
- cast_numeric on body_mass_g (auto-approved) – converted text numbers to numeric.
- exclude_rows [0,17,34] (approved) – removed impossible body mass rows per rules.

Result (54 rows used, version 2):
- female: mean body_mass_g = 3735.0 g
- male: mean body_mass_g = 4570.83 g

Caveats: 3 rows excluded due to out-of-range body mass; if those were data entry errors with extra zeros, true means could differ slightly. Species/island label variants exist but do not affect this sex-grouped average.
